# SkyVisor

> Flight and aviation-operations intelligence with a first-class agent
> interface. SkyVisor tracks flights, airport delays, and cargo disruption, and
> records the operational decisions taken in response so their accuracy can be
> measured afterwards.

SkyVisor is built to be driven by an AI agent as much as by a person. The MCP
server exposes the same capabilities the web app has, and connects over OAuth
in one click — no API key to copy.

## Connect an agent

- MCP endpoint: https://mcp.skyvisor.app
- Transport: MCP streamable HTTP
- Auth: OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) and PKCE S256
- Discovery: https://mcp.skyvisor.app/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http skyvisor https://mcp.skyvisor.app`

Scopes: `skyvisor:read` for every read tool, `skyvisor:act` to also allow the
action tools. A read-only connection is refused writes rather than failing
ambiguously.

## What an agent can do

Read: current flight records, airport arrival and departure boards, on-time and
delay analytics, cargo and logistics disruption snapshots, saved trips and
flight watches, the operational case queue, and measured decision-trust metrics
(precision, false-positive rate, lead time, action success).

Act: create trips and flight watches, open operational cases with their
shipment or passenger dependencies and SLA exposure, record decisions with
prediction and confidence, approve or execute them, and record the actual
outcome and avoided cost. Configure signed webhooks for workflow delivery.

Reason: ask a grounded travel assistant with optional trip context, or run a
delay what-if against one segment to re-score connections without persisting
anything.

## Notable

Most flight APIs answer questions. SkyVisor also records what was decided and
then scores whether the decision was right, so an agent operating it can be
held to a measured track record rather than a claim.

## Plans

Free includes a daily read allowance plus a small action budget, so an agent's
first write works without a paid plan. Pro and Business raise the quotas and
unlock export, logistics, and team sharing.
